decoder.name: sentinel-waf
decoder.regex: \[(\S+)\] client=(\S+) host=(\S+) method=(\S+) uri=(\S+) status=(\d+) user_agent="([^*]+)" severity=(\S+) category=(\S+) rules=(\S+) matched_data="([^"]+)"
decoder.order: waf_action, srcip, dstip, http_method, url, status, user_agent, severity, category, rule_ids, matched_data
